# Size results (generated by run_size.py)

Test set: 10558 events, 361 batches (mean 29.2 ev/batch), installs=10, profile=rich. Unit: bytes per event of the HTTP body (sum of compressed bodies / events). Dictionaries trained on seed=2 only.

## 1. Format x compressor matrix (B/event)

| format | none | gzip-1 | gzip-6 | gzip-9 | br-5 | br-11 | zstd-3 | zstd-19 | zstd-3+dict16K | zstd-19+dict16K | zstd-19+dict16K min-frame |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| V1 JSON (exact current) | 1024.6 | 170.8 | 143.1 | 139.8 | 123.1 | 112.1 | 134.5 | 123.3 | 113.5 | 96.5 | 96.2 |
| V1 JSON all JSON-level opts | 299.6 | 109.9 | 93.7 | 92.8 | 84.3 | 75.4 | 91.7 | 83.1 | 76.7 | 63.0 | 62.7 |
| MessagePack rows (V1 structure) | 885.7 | 157.0 | 144.0 | 141.6 | 121.8 | 112.5 | 132.3 | 125.5 | 110.1 | 97.5 | 97.2 |
| CBOR rows (V1 structure) | 905.3 | 163.9 | 146.1 | 143.2 | 123.9 | 114.4 | 134.3 | 127.9 | 112.3 | 100.2 | 99.9 |
| MessagePack compact rows | 150.8 | 74.6 | 71.8 | 71.8 | 67.8 | 63.4 | 74.5 | 67.3 | 65.9 | 55.3 | 55.0 |
| Protobuf generic Prop{k,v} | 217.8 | 86.1 | 80.4 | 80.2 | 72.0 | 68.5 | 77.0 | 71.4 | 64.5 | 56.5 | 56.2 |
| Protobuf typed (codegen) | 157.8 | 77.4 | 74.7 | 74.5 | 69.0 | 64.9 | 77.4 | 70.4 | 67.5 | 56.8 | 56.5 |
| MTB2 row-major | 114.1 | 77.1 | 75.5 | 75.4 | 71.7 | 68.6 | 78.0 | 74.0 | 55.6 | 51.1 | 50.8 |
| MTB2 columnar | 114.1 | 74.1 | 72.7 | 72.7 | 68.6 | 64.9 | 74.5 | 70.7 | 51.2 | 47.4 | 47.1 |
| MTB2 columnar + CAS ctx/shape cache | 105.7 | 71.1 | 69.9 | 69.8 | 65.8 | 62.8 | 71.0 | 67.9 | 49.6 | 45.9 | 45.6 |

Baseline = V1 JSON gzip-1 = 170.8 B/event (SDK uses CompressionLevel.Fastest).

Reduction vs baseline for selected cells:

- V1 JSON (exact current) / gzip-6: 143.1 B/event, 16.2% smaller
- V1 JSON (exact current) / br-11: 112.1 B/event, 34.4% smaller
- V1 JSON (exact current) / zstd-19+dict16K: 96.5 B/event, 43.5% smaller
- V1 JSON all JSON-level opts / gzip-6: 93.7 B/event, 45.1% smaller
- V1 JSON all JSON-level opts / zstd-19+dict16K: 63.0 B/event, 63.1% smaller
- Protobuf typed (codegen) / zstd-19+dict16K: 56.8 B/event, 66.7% smaller
- MTB2 columnar / gzip-6: 72.7 B/event, 57.4% smaller
- MTB2 columnar / zstd-19+dict16K: 47.4 B/event, 72.2% smaller
- MTB2 columnar + CAS ctx/shape cache / zstd-19+dict16K min-frame: 45.6 B/event, 73.3% smaller

## 8. Server response size per batch (B/event)

- V1 JSON response, raw: 44.8; gzip-6: 27.8
- MTB2 ack (spec 7.2: 1 B status + varint first_seq + varint count + varint server_time_delta + policy_epoch) ~ 8-12 B per batch = 0.34 B/event (computed, not encoded here)
